name: nonmath-mc-hard-v2
note: HARD non-mathematical multiple-choice bank for E13 discriminant validity. v1 saturated (even 8B models ~97%), so this set uses obscure-but-canonical facts (history, literature, music, art, philosophy, linguistics, geography) chosen so weak models drop to ~40-60% while frontier stay high -> real spread across the weak->frontier range, like AIME. Single unambiguous answer, exact-letter machine grading, no LLM judge. Strictly non-quantitative (no arithmetic/algebra).

questions.question: In which year was the Treaty of Karlowitz, ending Ottoman expansion into central Europe, signed?

Which medieval Persian poet wrote the 'Masnavi', a foundational work of Sufi literature?
The Defenestration of Prague in 1618 helped trigger which conflict?

choices.C: The War of the Austrian Succession
